import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
from werkzeug.sansio.multipart import MultipartDecoder, Data, Field, File, NeedData, Epilogue, Preamble

boundary = b'boundary123'
header = b'--' + boundary + b'\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"f\"; filename=\"f\"\r\n\r\n'
zeros = b'\x00' * 100
tail = b'\r\n--' + boundary + b'--\r\n'

full = header + zeros + tail
# split so that chunk1 ends right after the CR of the CRLF before boundary
split_point = len(header) + len(zeros) + 1  # includes the \r
chunk1 = full[:split_point]
chunk2 = full[split_point:]
print('chunk1 tail:', chunk1[-5:])
print('chunk2 head:', chunk2[:5])

parser = MultipartDecoder(boundary)
out = bytearray()
for data in [chunk1, chunk2, None]:
    parser.receive_data(data)
    event = parser.next_event()
    while not isinstance(event, (Epilogue, NeedData)):
        if isinstance(event, Data):
            out.extend(event.data)
        event = parser.next_event()

print(len(out), out[-10:])
print('expected', len(zeros))

import sys, io
sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
from werkzeug.formparser import MultiPartParser

boundary = b'boundary123'
header = b'--' + boundary + b'\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"f\"; filename=\"f\"\r\n\r\n'
buffer_size = 65536
zeros_len = buffer_size - len(header) - 1
zeros = b'\x00' * zeros_len
tail = b'\r\n--' + boundary + b'--\r\n'
full = header + zeros + tail
print('total len', len(full), 'first chunk would be', buffer_size)
print(full[buffer_size-1:buffer_size+3])

parser = MultiPartParser(buffer_size=buffer_size)
content_type = b'multipart/form-data; boundary=' + boundary
fields, files = parser.parse(io.BytesIO(full), boundary, len(full))
for name, fs in files.items(True) if hasattr(files,'items') else []:
    pass
import werkzeug.datastructures as ds
for k in files:

import sys, re
sys.path.insert(0,'src')
from werkzeug.sansio.multipart import LINE_BREAK
boundary=b'boundary123'
boundary_re = re.compile(rb'%s--%s(--[^\S\n\r]*%s?|[^\S\n\r]*%s)' % (LINE_BREAK, re.escape(boundary), LINE_BREAK, LINE_BREAK), re.MULTILINE)
data = b'\r\n--boundary123--\r\n'
m = boundary_re.search(data)
print(m, m.start(), m.end())
